title: Venezuelan Serrano Ham Wraps
description: A quick and delicious snack or meal option, featuring the flavors of Venezuela and savory serrano ham.
instructions: 1. Lay a wrap flat on a clean surface.
2. Arrange 2 ounces of thinly sliced ham and 1 ounce of thinly sliced serrano ham on the center of the wrap.
3. Drizzle 2 tablespoons of Venezuelan salsa over the ham.
4. Sprinkle chopped cilantro over the top.
5. Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling.
6. Fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
7. Serve immediately, with a lime wedge on the side.
